description: Get specific nodes from a Figma file by comma-separated node IDs.

depth.description: Optional depth of the node subtrees to return, as a number of levels.

file_key.description: Figma file key identifying the file containing the nodes.

node_ids.description: Comma-separated list of node IDs to retrieve from the file.

version.description: Optional specific version of the file to read the nodes from, identified by its version ID.

name: get_file_nodes
